status: proposal-only; not a runtime character index
policy: No generated mentions or offsets until both editions are complete and pinned. Use staged, spoiler-aware snapshots following the existing characters.v1 convention at integration. Intro chapters are discovery aids, not publication-ready appearance coordinates.

characters.name: Josef K.
characters.body: A senior bank employee who expects reason, status and professional competence to make his position clear. An unexplained arrest draws those expectations into question.

characters.name: Mrs Grubach
characters.body: K.’s landlady, whose concern for her lodgers includes close attention to their reputations. Her domestic judgments accompany the first official intrusion.

characters.name: Miss Bürstner
characters.body: A typist whose room is used during K.’s arrest. She listens to his account while insisting on her own time, space and responsibility.

characters.name: The examining magistrate
characters.body: He presides over the crowded room where K. tries to turn his examination into a public challenge to the proceedings.

characters.name: K.’s uncle
characters.body: A relative from the country who takes an urgent interest in K.’s case and introduces him to a lawyer.

characters.name: Huld
characters.body: A lawyer approached through K.’s uncle. His account of defence work raises questions about access, influence and dependence.

characters.name: Leni
characters.body: A woman in the lawyer’s household who takes a close personal interest in K.

characters.name: Titorelli
characters.body: A painter with connections to the court, approached as a possible source of help.

characters.name: Block
characters.body: A merchant whose experience of the proceedings gives K. another perspective on seeking legal assistance.

characters.name: The priest
characters.body: A clergyman whose conversation with K. turns on how a story about access to the law can be understood.

characters.name: Franz
characters.body: One of the guards at K.’s arrest. Keep him distinct from Willem and from the supervisor.

characters.name: Willem
characters.body: The other guard at K.’s arrest, who explains the authority’s connection to guilt.

characters.name: The supervisor
characters.body: The official who speaks to K. in Miss Bürstner’s room. Not the examining magistrate.
